request: Add third rotor blade to the assembly. It should have the same design as the other two. Radii should applied on all four long edges of the blade. Adjust central portion of all three blades so that there is a space for a new blade - reduce thickness of the central portion to cca 0,42mm. New blade should go through the center of the stack.

actions.operation: Create and add a third rotor blade by reproducing the design of the existing rotor blades.
actions.target: The rotor-blade assembly and the new third rotor blade.
actions.relational_constraint: The third blade must have the same design as the other two blades.
actions.unresolved_reference: The model identifies the two existing blade-like members as SEC-01 and SEC-02 rather than as rotor blades. Their common D-shaped hollow-rail design can be used as the source. The exact in-plane angular orientation of the third blade is not specified; preserve the existing two blade orientations and place the new blade through the central axis, using an evenly distributed three-blade angular layout only if that rotor arrangement is confirmed by design intent.
steps: Treat SEC-01, the diagonal hollow rail, and SEC-02, the vertical hollow rail, as the two existing rotor blades because both are long D-profile hollow members passing through the central clamp and pivot stack.
Create a new independent solid/body and assign it the new section identifier SEC-06. Do not remove or replace SEC-01, SEC-02, SEC-03, SEC-04, or SEC-05.

Use a datum plane normal to the intended longitudinal axis of the new blade. Derive the section from an undisturbed end region of SEC-01 or SEC-02, using end faces 0000 or 0010 and 0014 or 0027 as dimensional references.

Project or reconstruct the existing D-shaped outer profile, including its broad planar walls and rounded outer side. Match the source blade width, nominal full thickness, large outer arc, and wall arrangement.

Reproduce the longitudinal internal bore from source faces 0011, 0015, or 0026 where the existing design requires the third blade to remain hollow. Keep the bore concentric with the new blade longitudinal axis and preserve the source wall thickness.

Extrude the section symmetrically in both directions from the assembly center so that the new blade has the same overall span and paired end geometry as the selected source blade. A symmetric mid-plane extrusion prevents axial offset of the blade relative to the pivot.

If the source blade is copied as a solid rather than resketched, suppress or remove source-specific central crossing cuts before placement. Rebuild the central relief for the new three-layer stack instead of retaining a relief intended for only two crossing blades.

Orient the new blade in the same global x-z rotor plane visible in the front and back views. Its longitudinal centerline must intersect x=0 and z=0, and its thickness direction must remain parallel to the global y-axis and to the central pin axis.

Set the new blade's angular position about the global y-axis according to the intended three-blade layout. If equal rotor spacing is required, constrain the three blade axes at 120-degree intervals; otherwise retain the two existing orientations and place the new blade at the specified free azimuth.

Keep SEC-06 as a separate blade body through the central stack unless the manufacturing definition explicitly requires a fused rotor. Verify that its outer spans clear the existing blades away from the intentionally overlapped central region.
Recreate equivalent terminal end caps and bore openings and confirm that the resulting third blade has the same functional hollow structural section as SEC-01 and SEC-02.

actions.operation: Apply radii or fillets to the blade edges.
actions.target: All four long edges of the referenced blade.
actions.relational_constraint: The radii must be applied to all four edges identified as the blade's long edges.
actions.unresolved_reference: The singular phrase 'the blade' is interpreted as the new SEC-06 blade. No numeric radius is supplied, so the radius should be measured from and matched to the corresponding longitudinal edge treatment of SEC-01 or SEC-02. The radius must not exceed the reduced 0.42 mm central thickness where the long-edge fillets continue through the thinned region.
steps: Use the longitudinal transitions between the broad planar walls and side surfaces of SEC-01 and SEC-02 as the visual and dimensional reference for the required edge radius.

On SEC-06, identify the four continuous edges running parallel to the blade longitudinal axis: the two long edges bordering one broad wall and the corresponding two long edges bordering the opposite broad wall.

Measure the existing source radius from the rounded longitudinal surfaces represented by faces 0001, 0007, 0008, 0017, and 0024, or retrieve the radius from the source blade feature history if available.
Create one constant-radius edge-fillet feature using all four long edges in a single selection set so that the treatment remains consistent and updates together.

Where a selected long edge is divided by the central thickness transition, enable tangent-chain propagation only when it produces a valid continuous radius. Otherwise apply separate but equal fillet features to the full-thickness and transition segments.

Limit or locally reduce the fillet at the 0.42 mm central neck if the copied full-size radius would consume the thin section. Preserve a measurable planar or smoothly curved central web rather than allowing the fillets to intersect.
Do not fillet the blade end-cap boundaries or the longitudinal bore openings unless those features are already rounded in the source design.
Inspect the result in front, back, top, bottom, left, right, and isometric views to confirm that all four long edges are rounded and that no edge was omitted behind the clamp plates.

actions.operation: Reduce the thickness of the central portions of the blades.
actions.target: The central portion of each of all three blades.
actions.relational_constraint: All three blade central portions must be adjusted to approximately the stated final thickness to provide space for the new blade.
actions.unresolved_reference: The central portions correspond to the local crossing and relief regions around x=0 and z=0. Thickness is interpreted along the global y-axis, normal to the broad blade faces and parallel to the central pivot axis. The exact longitudinal extent of each 0.42 mm region and the running clearance between the three stacked layers are not specified and must be set from the clamp envelope and manufacturing clearance requirements.
steps: Use the global x-z plane through the assembly center as the blade plan plane and the global y-axis as the thickness direction. The pin and boss axis in SEC-05 establishes the exact center of the thinning operation.
For SEC-01, localize the central portion using transition faces 0003 and 0005, central interface face 0004, underside face 0013, and central cylindrical clearance face 0012.
For SEC-02, localize the central portion using transition faces 0019, 0020, 0022, central crossing face 0021, and central cylindrical clearance face 0028.

For SEC-06, define an equivalent central region centered on the global y-axis and bounded longitudinally so that it fully spans every crossing with the other two blades while remaining inside the front and rear clamp-plate footprint.

Create symmetric pocket or face-offset features on the two broad sides of each blade central region. Remove equal material from both sides until the remaining central web thickness is approximately 0.42 mm.
Dimension the final thickness directly between the two resulting central broad faces rather than dimensioning only the pocket depth. This avoids dependence on the original blade thickness.

Keep the reduced web centered on the intended layer center plane for each blade before applying stack offsets. Use symmetric-to-plane or mid-plane constraints to prevent unintended lateral displacement during thickness edits.

Create smooth ramps or tangent blends between each 0.42 mm central web and the original full-thickness outer blade. Use the existing central blends 0003, 0005, 0019, 0020, and 0022 as the design-language reference.

Preserve the central pivot clearance through every blade. Recut or update the coaxial opening so that the SEC-01 face 0012, SEC-02 face 0028, and the corresponding new SEC-06 opening remain concentric with SEC-05.

Arrange the three 0.42 mm central webs as three separate layers along the y-axis. Center the complete three-layer stack on the assembly mid-plane, with nominal layer center offsets of approximately -0.42 mm, 0 mm, and +0.42 mm before adding any required running clearance.

If physical movement or assembly clearance is required, add the specified inter-blade clearance between adjacent 0.42 mm layers and increase the total stack thickness accordingly. Do not infer zero-clearance contact for rotating components.
Maintain the original full-thickness geometry outside the central transition regions so the blade bending stiffness, end interfaces, and hollow sections remain unchanged.

Run section and interference checks through the global y-axis. Confirm that the three central webs do not volumetrically overlap, remain inside the opposing clamp plates, and retain sufficient material around the pin opening.

Because 0.42 mm is very thin relative to the existing approximately 12.7 mm rail envelope and the 6.35 mm pin radius, verify manufacturability, minimum edge distance, and bearing strength before final release.

actions.operation: Position the new blade in the assembly.
actions.relational_constraint: The new blade must pass through the center of the stack.
actions.unresolved_reference: The stack is localized as the opposing SEC-03 and SEC-04 clamp plates, the thinned central regions of SEC-01 and SEC-02, and the coaxial SEC-05 boss/pin system. Its center is x=0, z=0 on the global y-axis. The precise angular orientation and ordering of the three blade layers along y remain unspecified.
steps: Use SEC-05 central pin cylinder face 0055 as the primary cylindrical datum and the global y-axis as the stack axis.

Use the front and rear clamp inner bearing faces 0039 and 0050 as the axial envelope of the central stack. The boss cylinders 0052 and 0054 and seating faces 0051 and 0053 provide secondary concentric and axial references.
Create a concentric assembly constraint between the new blade's central clearance opening and the SEC-05 pin cylinder 0055.

Create a center or midpoint constraint so that the longitudinal centerline of SEC-06 passes through x=0 and z=0. This ensures that the blade goes through the geometric center rather than merely passing near the clamp.
Rotate SEC-06 about the y-axis to its required rotor azimuth. Do not rotate it out of the common x-z rotor plane.

Assign the three reduced central webs to separate y-axis layers. Prefer placing the new blade in the middle layer if 'through the center of the stack' means the central axial layer; place the two existing blades on the opposing outer layers.

Alternatively, if 'through the center' refers only to the pivot center and a different layer sequence is required for assembly, retain concentricity with face 0055 and apply the specified front-to-rear layer order.
Check that the total thickness of the three 0.42 mm webs plus running clearances fits between bearing faces 0039 and 0050 without interfering with boss seats 0051 and 0053.

Update the central pin or boss length only if the verified three-layer stack exceeds the existing available grip length. Preserve the current pin diameter and coaxial relationships unless a separate fastener-sizing change is authorized.
Do not modify the outer faces or rounded-square perimeter of SEC-03 and SEC-04 unless interference analysis shows that their inner recesses cannot contain the new stack.
Perform static interference detection among SEC-01, SEC-02, SEC-06, SEC-03, SEC-04, and SEC-05. Allow only intended pin-to-hole and clamp-to-stack contacts.

Perform a rotational clearance study about the y-axis if the assembly is intended to pivot. Confirm that the blade transition ramps, fillets, clamp shoulders, and central bosses do not collide over the required motion range.

Regenerate all views and verify that three distinct blade axes pass through the central pivot, the new blade remains geometrically consistent with the existing two, and the clamp and pivot stack remain coaxial.

intention: Provide sufficient space in the central stack to accommodate a third rotor blade.
Integrate the new blade through the center of the existing blade stack.
